steps.title: Pick up tips on both pipettes
steps.instruction: Load tip racks and have the P20 single GEN2 and the P300 single pipettes pick up fresh tips in preparation for adding diluent.

steps.title: Add nuclease‑free water
steps.instruction: Using the same tip for each well, add the calculated volume of nuclease‑free water from tube A1 located in slot 4 to each specified well of the destination plate in slot 2. Choose the P20 or P300 pipette based on the required transfer volume.

substeps.instruction: Select the appropriate pipette (P20 or P300) according to the calculated water volume for the well.
Aspirate the calculated volume of nuclease‑free water from tube A1 (slot 4).
Dispense the water into the corresponding well of the plate in slot 2.
Repeat for all wells, re‑using the same tip for each addition.

steps.title: Add sample and mix
steps.instruction: For each sample well in the source plate (slot 1), add the calculated volume of sample to the same well in the destination plate (slot 2) and mix. Use a new tip for each sample and select the pipette based on the transfer volume.

substeps.instruction: Select the appropriate pipette (P20 or P300) according to the calculated sample volume.
Aspirate the calculated volume of sample from the source well in slot 1.
Dispense the sample into the matching well in the destination plate in slot 2.
Mix the well (e.g., by pipette mixing) to ensure homogeneity.
Discard the tip before proceeding to the next sample.

steps.title: Report non‑normalizable wells
steps.instruction: At the end of the protocol, generate and display a list of wells that could not be normalized because the starting concentration was insufficient to reach the target concentration.
